verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any export or migration capability for scraped data or job configurations in a portable, provider-neutral format. Nearby features are different capabilities and earn no credit here: the Downloads API retrieves files downloaded during a session, and the Optimize tool turns an Agent run into a Stagehand script, but neither is documented as a way to export data or configs for another provider. Community mentions of open-source alternatives do not show the product itself offers anti-lock-in export.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export my scraped data and job configurations in a portable format to migrate to another provider without lock-in
